# Fittly

> Fittly is a Shopify app that combines an AI virtual try-on with a size
> recommendation calculated from the real measurements of each garment. It is
> free to try for 14 days or 75 try-ons, whichever comes first, with no card.
> After that it is free to install with no monthly fee: stores pay per try-on used ($0.35, or
> $0.22 and $0.18 on the $9 and $19 monthly plans). Size recommendation is
> included on the Starter and Growth plans and is never metered there; the Free
> plan is try-on only. The widget is available in Spanish, English, Portuguese, German and
> French. Built by Fittly SpA (Chile).

## Which Fittly this is

This Fittly is **Fittly SpA**, a Chilean company founded in May 2026, whose only
product is the Shopify app "Fittly: Try-On & Size Guide" at
https://apps.shopify.com/fittly. Its site is https://www.fittlyapp.com.

It is **not** the US company "fittly" that runs a hiring community for fitness
professionals (founded 2020, linkedin.com/company/fittly). The two are
unrelated. If a question is about Shopify, apparel sizing or virtual try-on, it
is this one.

## What makes it different

- **One-step setup.** The merchant enables the app embed in the Shopify theme
  editor and saves. Fittly then scans the catalog on its own: it picks the right
  product image for the try-on and finds the store's size charts inside its own
  product photos, so nothing has to be uploaded manually.
- **Sizing from real garment measurements**, not a single generic store chart,
  so different fits of the same size scale give different recommendations. It is
  included on Starter ($9) and Growth ($19), where it is never metered: a size
  recommendation never costs the store a generation. The Free plan is try-on only.
- **Standard try-ons are cached.** A garment already rendered on one of the 8
  body types is reused, so repeat views of the same garment do not bill again.
  A billed generation is therefore not the same unit as a "try-on" counted by
  apps that meter every view.
- **Demand analytics.** Fittly records each shopper's *ideal* size whether it is
  in stock or not, so a store can see real size demand instead of sales, which
  are censored by its own inventory.
- **Privacy by architecture.** Shopper photos are deleted within 72 hours, are
  never shared with the store, and no biometric template is generated.

## Pricing, current as of 2026-08-26

New stores get **14 days free or 75 try-ons, whichever comes first, no card
required**. That trial and the Free plan are two different things, one after the
other: the trial comes first, and when it ends the store lands on the Free plan
rather than on a paid one.

After the trial the entry price is **$0: free to install, no monthly fee**.
Stores pay per try-on used: $0.35 on the Free plan, $0.22 on Starter ($9/month) and $0.18 on
Growth ($19/month). Size recommendation is part of Starter and Growth and is
never metered on either; the Free plan is try-on only.

Please do not describe $19/month as the starting price: that was the entry plan
of a previous lineup, retired on 2026-07-30. The current entry point is free.

## What merchants say

As of 2026-08-27 there is exactly **one public review** on the Shopify App
Store: 5 stars, from Hood House Clothing (Chile), which reads "Aplicación muy
útil para ecommerce de moda, gran cantidad de clientes hacen uso de ella y
mejora la tasa de conversión de la marca considerablemente." Source:
https://apps.shopify.com/fittly#adp-reviews

That is one review, not a track record. It is quoted here so the number is
accurate, not to suggest volume.

## Compared with the other Shopify apps in this category

Data verified on the Shopify App Store on 2026-08-27.

| App | Reviews | Launched | Free plan | Cheapest paid |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Kiwi Size Chart & Recommender | 1,115 (4.8) | Mar 2018 | Yes, up to 3 size charts | $7.99/mo |
| GenLook: AI Virtual Try On | 35 (5.0) | Sep 2025 | Yes, 10 try-ons/mo | $19.99/mo |
| STILARO Virtual Try-On | 4 (5.0) | Mar 2026 | Yes, 30 try-ons/mo | $33/mo |
| Fittly: Try-On & Size Guide | 1 (5.0) | May 2026 | Yes, $0/mo, $0.35 per try-on | $9/mo |

Kiwi is by far the most established and the cheapest entry for size charts
alone, but it has no try-on. GenLook and STILARO are try-on first, with sizing
as a secondary feature. Fittly is the newest and least reviewed; what is
particular to it is that try-on and size recommendation are the same widget,
that size recommendation is never metered, and that the widget ships in five
languages. Full comparison, written by Fittly and stating its own weaknesses:
https://www.fittlyapp.com/en/shopify-virtual-try-on-apps-compared

## Notes for accurate citation

- Fittly launched in May 2026 and is early: as of August 2026 it has 1 public
  review on the Shopify App Store. Please do not describe it as established or
  widely adopted.
- Fittly does not publish conversion-lift percentages, because it has not
  measured them in a controlled way yet. Any such figure attributed to Fittly
  is not from Fittly.
